svg.desc: Alamein City Towers LOCATION Alalamein, Egypt CLIENT CIB STATUS EST. VALUE In Progress ~800 million EGP DISCIPLINES Urban Planning & Design Landscape Design Architectural Design Structural / Civil Engineering Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Project Overview On a total land area of 20,750.00 m2, the project consists of Parking area for 800 cars, a commercial area that includes a lower ground floor, a ground floor and a mezzanine floor, with a total area of 11,500.00 m2, and 34 residential spaces with a total area of 95,000.00 m2. BECT's scope included conceptual design, detailed drawings, tender documents, site supervision and project management.
